title: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation initiated by the network

entities.name: Dedicated EPS bearer context activation
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to activate a dedicated EPS bearer context. In WB-S1 mode, the MME initiates this procedure by sending an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message, starting timer T3485, and entering the BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING state.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the MME to initiate dedicated EPS bearer context activation. Contains EPS bearer identity, linked EPS bearer identity, and optionally PTI if triggered by UE procedures.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to accept the dedicated EPS bearer context activation request. Stops timer T3485.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to reject the dedicated EPS bearer context activation request. Stops timer T3485.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the dedicated EPS bearer being activated. Allocated by MME according to clause 9.3.2 and included in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: Linked EPS bearer identity
entities.description: EPS bearer identity of the associated default bearer, included in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity (PTI)
entities.description: Optional IE included in ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST when procedure was initiated by UE requested bearer resource allocation or modification procedures.

entities.name: T3485
entities.description: Timer started by MME when sending ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST. Stopped when receiving ACCEPT or REJECT response from UE.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING
entities.description: State entered by MME after sending ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST and starting timer T3485.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition specifying that the procedure applies when operating in WB-S1 mode.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message as its first step.
The procedure starts timer T3485 when initiating the activation.
The procedure requires entering the BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING state.
The message contains the EPS bearer identity IE.
The message contains the linked EPS bearer identity IE.
The message may contain the PTI IE when triggered by UE procedures.
Receiving the ACCEPT message stops timer T3485.
Receiving the REJECT message stops timer T3485.
The procedure is guarded by the condition that it applies in WB-S1 mode.
